Product page: Included with an Active WoW Subscription; Available on Windows/Mac.
Optional upgrade editions: Skyborne Heroic Pack, Skyborne Epic Pack and the limited-time Warcraft Forever Collection.

The Skyborne Epic Pack includes everything in the Skyborne Heroic Pack, plus beta access beginning September 17, 30 days of World of Warcraft Game Time starting November 4, additional cosmetics, pets, tabards, and three total Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes.
Beta began September 17; access via opt-in selection or eligible bundles (Skyborne Epic Pack, Warcraft Forever Collection).
The beta will be available through October 21, the last full day of testing.
the level cap will be set to 20 and will be raised to 30 later in the beta.
Week 1: new race and zone Skyborne and Zephras Isle; Hall of Thanes (Level 13–18); Ruins of Lordaeron (Level 15–20); all zone content up to level 20.
A “Server Slam” open window is announced; no date is given in the source.

t: What World of Warcraft: Forever is — Positioning
x: Built as a new permanent home alongside modern and Classic WoW.

t: What World of Warcraft: Forever is — Positioning
x: This is not a mode, a season, or a new version of Classic.

t: What World of Warcraft: Forever is — Setting
x: Set after the events of Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom and before Molten Core, players will return to the original continents, adventure to level 60.

t: What World of Warcraft: Forever is — Design principles
x: Four pillars: approachable and familiar, the world as the main character, the journey before the destination, and protecting and nurturing the social experiences.

t: What World of Warcraft: Forever is — Design principles
x: no flying mounts, no level scaling.
more than a thousand new quests woven throughout the level 1–60 journey (product page: 1000+ new quests).
Mount Hyjal: explore the aftermath of Archimonde’s defeat and Darkwhisper Gorge.
Shen'dralas: a long-hidden mystery between Mulgore and Desolace.
Riverglades: more than 150 new quests across much of the mid-30s to mid-40s experience.
Zephras Isle: an elemental skybound starting experience from levels 1 through 12.
New playable race from Zephras Isle; faction chosen at character creation.
Horde-aligned Skyborne embrace elemental traditions and gain access to the Shaman class, while Alliance-aligned Skyborne pursue the arcane legacy of their ancestors and gain access to the Mage class.
Both factions can also play Warriors, Hunters, Rogues, and Druids, with new Skyborne druid forms.

t: Skyborne & class-race combos — New class-race combos
x: Gnome Priest, Human Hunter, Dwarf Shaman, Orc Mage, Troll Warlock, and Undead Paladin.

t: Skyborne & class-race combos — New class-race combos
x: Wording difference: the product page says the Forsaken Paladin or Dwarf Shaman; the Deep Dive says Undead Paladin.
revamps to all classes and specializations.
Talents from level 10 with milestone talents at 11, 21 and 31 points, now joined by a new 16-point milestone; Dual Specialization also becomes available at level 40.
Abilities may continue to evolve throughout the beta test.

Aimed Shot is now granted as a baseline ability to all Hunters at level 20. Traps usable in combat (30-second cooldown); Foxes are a new pet family; Pets now get increased stats based on their Hunter’s gear.
Fear Ward and Devouring Plague are now available to all Priests at level 20. Warriors: adjustments that make Rage more reliable.

nine new dungeons: the Hall of Thanes beneath Ironforge, the Ruins of Lordaeron, a mysterious excavation site above Whelgar’s Excavation, the chaotic City of Dalaran, Blackmaw Hold, the Drowned City, Krol’dok Stronghold, Alcaz Prison, and the Shaper’s Terrace (quoted as written; one is not formally named).
Unique dungeon boss items are now blue quality; hundreds of new drops have been added.
The Barrow Deeps is planned as a maximum-level 10-player challenge, while Hyjal Summit will bring 20-player raid encounters.
New raids unlock on December 9, followed by more raids, dungeons, PvP updates, Hardcore, a revamped iconic raid.
PvP progression has two parts: Honor and Rank Points.
Ranks have a weekly cap; ultimate titles High Warlord for the Horde or Grand Marshal for the Alliance.
Honor buys a blue-quality and an epic-quality set; the epic set requires the blue piece plus an Emboldened Seal (rank-gated).
Seasonal weekly tasks grant Honor and Rank Points; three per season grant a Legacy Point.
15v15 battleground off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh: Darkspear Raiders vs Theramore Expeditionary Force.
Four capture points plus a central flag; The first team to earn 2000 points wins!
World of Warcraft: Forever is going realmless; Each ruleset functions more like its own large ecosystem than a single traditional realm.
cross-ruleset grouping is not supported.
over 600 new recipes across professions and level ranges, Blueprint recipes from dungeon bosses.
First campsite objects learned once a profession reaches skill level 20.
WoW: Forever’s Legacy system rewards account-wide benefits every time you progress a character’s adventure.

opt-in Transmog, modern and Classic visual presets, High-Definition (HD) and Standard-Definition (SD) character-model options, restored Classic animations for HD character models, and official gamepad support.
